profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Backend & Platform Engineering | Python, Applied AI & Agentic Development | Data Architecture
profile.summary:
I build Python platforms, production AI services, and agentic development workflows. My background spans enterprise data architecture, cross-team technical leadership, and hands-on delivery at QuotaPath, American Express, and AlertMedia.

I’m also the sole founder and engineer behind Hunnie Homes, a pre-launch, AI-native property-management SaaS for independent landlords!

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Sole founder and engineer building a pre-launch property-management SaaS for independent landlords. Own product engineering and infrastructure, including a conversational AI assistant and documented agentic workflows that support development from planning through code review.

positions.title: Senior AI/ML Software Engineer
positions.description: Built production Python/FastAPI services supporting financial crime screening and helped a distributed ML team establish software engineering practices. Focused on reliable inference, observability, consistent development environments, and code review, alongside exploratory work on LLM-assisted case summarization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed backend services and integrations for an emergency communications platform using Django, Celery, and RabbitMQ. Led improvements to administrative access controls, supported production systems, and mentored engineers through code reviews and design guidance.
positions.insights: Skills: Stakeholder Management · Team Management · Database Design · Microservices · Agile Methodologies · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Hands-on Technical Leadership · Django · Data Modeling

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Stakeholder Management · Team Management · Database Design · Microservices · Agile Methodologies · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Hands-on Technical Leadership · Data Modeling

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Hands-on Technical Leadership

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Developer at FBC, helping to automate many manual business processes and improve the existing data processing pipeline as part of the core operations for the company.

Also responsible for automating reports and providing visualizations as needed to help extract the most value out of the business data.
positions.insights: Skills: Database Design · Agile Methodologies · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Django · Data Modeling

positions.title: SQL Developer
positions.description:
Worked as part of a 5 member startup team to assist with the design and development of the back-end infrastructure for our web and mobile applications.

Main responsibilities included database architecture, SQL development (SP's, Functions, etc.).
Additionally, I provided some data visualization and analysis using Python and some common data science/visualization libraries.
positions.insights: Skills: Database Design · Agile Methodologies · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Django · Data Modeling

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
UpStge is a video streaming platform designed to help aspiring musicians get discovered.

What started as a vision in 2010 became a reality in 2014 when a team of college friends and myself developed a working prototype of the site, which went on to win a nationwide competition, and also enabled us to secure funding.

Still actively working on this project with hopes of bringing a better experience to users and delivering a platform which helps undiscovered talent have a greater exposure!

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
•	Work as part of a centralized team to support various business units that require database support.
•	Collaborate and Communicate: Analyze business requirements, support various business teams, attend stand-ups and planning sessions. 
•	Data Modeling: Apply appropriate design methodologies to deliver conceptual, logical, and physical models, based off business requirements.
•	Database Administration (Primary: Oracle, SQL Server Secondary: Mongo, Postgres) (3 years)– Deploy and maintain data structures, create and manage users/roles/access, export/import data, SQL experience, document changes across several environments (development, test/QA, production)

positions.title: Data Model Technical Specialist
positions.description:
- Create and maintain data under a team of professional data architects and database administrators.
- Reverse engineer data models from existing databases.
- Analyze project requirements/needs to determine best implementation given existing structures.
- Design and develop SharePoint solutions that help automate internal business processes.

positions.title: It Support
positions.description:
- Responded to requests for technical assistance by phone, email, remotely, and face-to-face.
- Diagnosed and resolved technical hardware and software issues.
- Connected devices to company networks (Windows, Mac OS, iOS, Android)
- Installed computer stations, corporate licensed software, laptops, and VoIP Phones.
- Logged and monitored technical issues using BMC Remedy ticketing system.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer and Information Sciences and Support Services
